"import json
import numpy as np
import openmdao.api as om
import pycycle.api as pyc


class Turbojet(pyc.Group):
    def setup(self):
        thermo_method = 'TABULAR'
        thermo_data = pyc.AIR_JETA_TAB_SPEC
        fuel_data = pyc.JETA_TAB_SPEC

        self.add_subsystem('fc', pyc.FlightCondition(thermo_method=thermo_method,
                                                     thermo_data=thermo_data))
        self.add_subsystem('inlet', pyc.Inlet(thermo_method=thermo_method,
                                              thermo_data=thermo_data))
        self.add_subsystem('comp', pyc.Compressor(thermo_method=thermo_method,
                                                  thermo_data=thermo_data, map=False))
        self.add_subsystem('burn', pyc.Combustor(thermo_method=thermo_method,
                                                 thermo_data=thermo_data,
                                                 fuel_thermo_data=fuel_data))
        self.add_subsystem('turb', pyc.Turbine(thermo_method=thermo_method,
                                               thermo_data=thermo_data, map=False))
        self.add_subsystem('noz', pyc.Nozzle(thermo_method=thermo_method,
                                             thermo_data=thermo_data,
                                             nozzleType='CD', design=True))
        self.add_subsystem('shaft', pyc.Shaft(num_elements=2), promotes=['*'])

        bal = self.add_subsystem('bal', om.BalanceComp())
        bal.add_balance('W', val=150.0, units='lbm/s', eq_units='lbf',
                        rhs_val=0.0, lower=1.0, upper=3000.0)
        bal.add_balance('PR_turb', val=0.40, eq_units='hp', rhs_val=0.0,
                        lower=0.15, upper=0.98)

        # flow connections
        self.connect('fc.Fl_I', 'inlet.Fl_I')
        self.connect('inlet.Fl_O', 'comp.Fl_I')
        self.connect('comp.Fl_O', 'burn.Fl_I')
        self.connect('burn.Fl_O', 'turb.Fl_I')
        self.connect('turb.Fl_O', 'noz.Fl_I')

        # shaft power balance
        self.connect('comp.power', 'pwr_in_0')
        self.connect('turb.power', 'pwr_in_1')

        # ambient static pressure
        self.connect('fc.Ps', 'noz.Ps')

        # CD nozzle design PR: fully expanded (Pt/Pamb)
        self.add_subsystem('noz_pr', om.ExecComp('PR = Pt/Ps',
                                                 PR=None, Pt={'units': 'psi'},
                                                 Ps={'units': 'psi'}))
        self.connect('turb.Fl_O:tot:P', 'noz_pr.Pt')
        self.connect('fc.Ps', 'noz_pr.Ps')
        self.connect('noz_pr.PR', 'noz.PR')

        # net thrust residual: Fg - ram drag - target
        self.add_subsystem('net', om.ExecComp(
            'resid = Fg - W*V/g - Fn_target',
            Fg={'units': 'lbf'}, W={'units': 'lbm/s'}, V={'units': 'ft/s'},
            Fn_target={'units': 'lbf'}, resid={'units': 'lbf'}, g=32.174))
        self.connect('noz.Fg', 'net.Fg')
        self.connect('fc.Fl_I:W', 'net.W')
        self.connect('fc.V', 'net.V')

        # balance connections
        self.connect('bal.W', 'fc.Fl_I:W')
        self.connect('bal.PR_turb', 'turb.PR')
        self.connect('net.resid', 'bal.W_resid')
        self.connect('pwr_out', 'bal.PR_turb_resid')

        # design inputs
        self.set_input_defaults('fc.alt', 0.0, units='ft')
        self.set_input_defaults('fc.MN', 0.01)
        self.set_input_defaults('inlet.MN', 0.5)
        self.set_input_defaults('comp.PR', 11.0)
        self.set_input_defaults('comp.eff', 0.90)
        self.set_input_defaults('comp.MN', 0.5)
        self.set_input_defaults('burn.Fl_O:tot:T', 2550.0, units='degR')
        self.set_input_defaults('burn.dPq', 0.95)
        self.set_input_defaults('burn.MN', 0.2)
        self.set_input_defaults('turb.eff', 0.90)
        self.set_input_defaults('turb.MN', 0.7)
        self.set_input_defaults('noz.MN', 1.0)
        self.set_input_defaults('net.Fn_target', 11000.0, units='lbf')
        self.set_input_defaults('Nmech', 120"
